_doc: Brick catalogue for generate_bricks.py. Units: metres in Unity mesh space after import (X = long axis, Y up, Z = short axis, pivot = centre of footprint at mid-height of the base brick/plate). size = [studs along X, studs along Z]; height_plates: 1 plate = 3.2 mm, 3 plates = 1 brick; bottom_plates = y of the underside in plate units. See README.md for sources.
